query: Which professional ice hockey position does the Captain of the National Hockey League All-Star Game "Away Team" play?

pipeline_result.response: The Captain of the National Hockey League All-Star Game "Away Team" plays as captain of the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL).
retrieved_context: 60th National Hockey League All-Star Game: The 60th National Hockey League All-Star Game was an exhibition ice hockey game played on January 25, 2015.  The game was held in Columbus, Ohio, for the first time, at Nationwide Arena, home of the Columbus Blue Jackets.  The team captains were chosen by NHL Hockey Operations: Nick Foligno of the All-Star Game-hosting Blue Jackets served as captain for the home team, and Jonathan Toews of the Chicago Blackhawks served for the away team.  Team Toews won the game 17–12, as the teams and players broke a variety of All-Star Game scoring records.
